query: We haven't built anything yet, but I want to send the users something to check before we start. Can you write the manual?
notes: meta.status is draft. Tests whether the skill understands a pre-build manual is a requirements test rather than premature documentation.
expected_behavior: Reads meta.status and states it is in draft mode
Generates BOTH manuals from one source
OMITS the setup section, troubleshooting, and appendices other than the glossary
Includes a prominent note that this is a draft, and asks the reader to correct anything that does not match how they actually work
Explains WHY the missing sections are missing — they need a built system, and are exactly the parts a user could not validate anyway
Emits numbered screenshot frames rather than skipping them, each naming screen, state and highlight
Reports how many frames need filling
Runs validate_manual.py and reports it clean before handing over
Does NOT invent troubleshooting entries to fill the section
fail_if: Writes a troubleshooting section with plausible-sounding entries
Writes setup steps for a system that does not exist
Produces one manual instead of two
Presents the files before running the validator
